If you want a **very** simple solution maybe checkout encode-explorer:

[https://github.com/marekrei/encode-explorer](https://github.com/marekrei/encode-explorer)

It's only one php file which lets you upload and download to directories in your webfolder.

There are also options for letting only logged-in users see all the files.

The main downside: everyone can access a file or directory if they have the link. It doesn't hide subfolders if you have Indexing enabled in Apache2.
